upload.frame_id: board-global complete NET publication serial starting at1, increments across ingress sessions, skip0; reset only full DDR reset/program
upload.timestamp_ms: board port1 completion time, not sender timestamp or CAM0 time

protocol.event: same serial as FRONT_RAW, latest complete valid NET publication at DDR/core key mailbox; invalid frame=0; exact frame may be missed by upload throttling => UNKNOWN
protocol.expiry: ingress peer session <=2s, complete-frame age<3s; no CAM0 fallback; invalidation latches event evidence invalid until next KEY

known_limit: CAM1 stripes remain unresolved; no image-quality changes
